one_line: The paper reports a Fraunhofer project (EnerTHERM) on energy efficiency of high-temperature heat treatments in the ceramic/refractory industry, with demonstrations of alumina sintering in small batch furnaces and in-situ measuring devices; a continuous roller kiln appears only in a thermographic image.
